name: 人生·财务
tagline: Log spending by speaking, get a nightly summary and a monthly look back
description: Records what you spend as you say it out loud, so the habit survives contact with a busy day. Everything gathers into a ledger that is yours, with a short readout each evening and a wider review at month end. Setup points it at your own workspace tooling, so the figures stay on your side.
author: KinGao476942
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
